fire_making.name: Fire Making
fire_making.desc: Free — everyone starts knowing how to make fire.

cooking.name: Cooking
cooking.desc: Cook raw food at a Campfire for more Hunger restored.

basic_agriculture.name: Basic Agriculture
basic_agriculture.desc: Unlocks the Farm Plot, which slowly grows food on its own.

tanning.name: Tanning
tanning.desc: Cure hides from wolves into Hide Armor.

shamanic_rites.name: Shamanic Rites
shamanic_rites.desc: Unlocks the Shrine, where Mana Awareness slowly gathers.

foundation_engineering.name: Foundation Engineering
foundation_engineering.desc: Lets you safely dig out the buried Nexus. Also unlocks Expedition Supplies and realm gear.

elemental_attunement.name: Elemental Attunement
elemental_attunement.desc: Tier 1 magic. Mages with Heat, Cold, Force or Motion vectors can now be recruited.
